description: Land Acquisition - Kothalawala, Bomiriya, Kaduwela D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire multiple land lots for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of properties, including lot numbers, assessment numbers, land types (garden, road, drain, etc.), claimants, original claimants, and exact land extents. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative actions.
